journey.title: Diagnose a closed gate
journey.purpose: Take an operator from a package that will not advance to the specific finding that blocks it and the remedy for it, without guessing which page to open.

steps.intent: Find the package that is not advancing.
See which rung closed and read the remedy.
Read the finding with its rule, file, and offset.
For a drift failure, read the pinned manifest revision to decide whether the skill or the CLI moved.
